_about: How a character's build shows in its art. Fighter Studio reads this to write the picture prompt.
traits: 'match' tokens are lowercase letters/digits, matched as substrings of a mutation's Name+Variant or a
natural body item's blueprint (the same matching the layered tile uses). The longest matching token wins.
kind: body = changes the whole body; part = an extra body part; effect = an aura or emission (never in the
base picture, it becomes a portrait effect layer); none = not visible.
separate: the part should stand clear of the torso so it can be cut into its own portrait layer.
covers: limb classes (head, arm, leg, tail, wing, tentacle, fin, roots) this trait already describes.
layer: how refart finds and cuts the part (phrase for Grounding DINO, tile layer it follows, z, fill).
Entries saved from the program's Character tab are appended to 'traits'.
brief: a shorter wording used when 'Short wording' is on (Designer cuts long prompts off).
style: chunky stylized video game character art, bold dark outline, cel shading with simple shaded materials, bright saturated colours
